about_the_game:
Chief Miner is a first-person incremental game about a (not so) humble Supreme Leader's fall from grace, into the lowly life of an asteroid miner.

A tale of humility, redemption, and an honest day's wor-- well, no. It's time to take over the universe again, Supreme Leader-style!

  • Destroy space rocks like there's no tomorrow (even a Supreme Leader needs startup capital)

  • Deck out your Death Stallion Mk IV (totally not just a regular mining ship)

  • Pretend to start a happy, fun colony and give your citizens everything they want (while funding the Planetary Tax Bureau like a military organization)

  • Let none stand in the way of your mighty.. immigration policies to send your enemies spiraling into ruin by luring their citizens away (not actual gameplay) -- That, and you know, destroying their planets to ensure compliance (there we are)

A relatable game about reclaiming things once there but lost -- overwhelming power, a loyal following, a universe to call your own

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 10 64-bit
  • Memory: 4 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Integrated GPU
  • DirectX: Version 11
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 11 64-bit
  • Memory: 12 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Dedicated GPU
  • DirectX: Version 11
